sources.summary: Nvidia's new data engine Flora labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 with GPT-6 Astra, while scoring slightly higher on quality. The open system, built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, catches errors in robot actions far more reliably than any competitor but sometimes falls short on descriptive accuracy. Nvidia is positioning Flora as a key piece of its strategy to control the entire robotics value chain. The article Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nvidia 的全新資料引擎 Flora 標註一小時的機器人影片只需 0.72 美元，相較於 GPT-6 Astra 的 88 美元大幅降低，且在品質評分上略高一籌。這個開放系統建構於三個經過微調的 Qwen3.5 模型之上，能夠比任何競爭對手更可靠地揪出機器人動作中的錯誤，但在描述準確度上偶有不足。Nvidia 將 Flora 定位為其掌控整個機器人價值鏈策略的關鍵拼圖。本文「Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra」首先出現於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: In Foreign Affairs, historian Niall Ferguson, researcher Lisa Klaassen, and former Google CEO Eric Schmidt cast the US and China as AI empires and every other country as a dependency. The race won't be decided by breakthroughs but by who can bankroll it. US corporations alone plan to spend more than $600 billion in 2026. Yet mounting debt, protests against data centers, and a potential chip crisis over Taiwan could stall both superpowers. The article Ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt calls OpenAI and Anthropic modern colonial trading companies appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在《外交事務》（Foreign Affairs）期刊中，歷史學家尼爾·弗格森（Niall Ferguson）、研究員麗莎·克拉森（Lisa Klaassen）以及前 Google 執行長艾瑞克·施密特（Eric Schmidt）將美國和中國描繪成人工智慧帝國，而其他所有國家則是依附國。這場競賽的勝負將取決於誰能提供資金，而不是技術突破。僅僅美國企業就計畫在 2026 年花費超過 600 落實（應譯為 6000 億，但原文為 600 billion 故譯為 6000 億美元）。然而，不斷增加的債務、對資料中心的抗議，以及可能因臺灣而引發的晶片危機，可能會使這兩個超級強權停滯不前。這篇題為「前 Google 執行長艾瑞克·施密特稱 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 為現代殖民貿易公司」的文章最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.summary: Smartphone agents don't get better by processing more data. They improve by training on as many different apps as possible. The researchers behind OpenMobile-2 built an open training environment with more than 110 applications, including 35 replicas of popular apps. On real Android devices, their model scores highest among open agents, the authors say. The article OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 智慧型手機代理程式不會透過處理更多資料而變得更好。它們透過對盡可能多的不同應用程式進行訓練來改進。OpenMobile-2 背後的研究人員建立了一個擁有 110 多個應用程式的開放訓練環境，其中包括 35 個熱門應用程式的複製品。作者表示，在真實的 Android 裝置上，他們的模型在開放代理程式中得分最高。這篇文章 OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models 最初發表於 The Decoder 。

sources.title_original: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth
sources.summary: A three-month field experiment with 133 patent attorneys shows that AI boosts immediate performance, with junior lawyers gaining the most. But when the AI is taken away, only senior attorneys retain the benefits, suggesting that baseline expertise is a prerequisite for turning AI-assisted practice into lasting skill. The article AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一項針對 133 名專利律師進行為期三個月的現場實驗表明，人工智慧能提升即時表現，其中資歷較淺的律師獲益最多。然而，當人工智慧被移除後，只有資深律師保有這些效益，這表明具備基礎專業知識是將人工智慧輔助實踐轉化為持久技能的先決條件。「人工智慧讓年輕專利律師瞬間變得更優秀，但可能悄悄阻礙他們的專業成長」一文首先發布於 The Decoder。

source_material.summary: Smartphone agents don't get better by processing more data. They improve by training on as many different apps as possible. The researchers behind OpenMobile-2 built an open training environment with more than 110 applications, including 35 replicas of popular apps. source_material.title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
source_material.summary: Nvidia's new data engine Flora labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 with GPT-6 Astra, while scoring slightly higher on quality. The open system, built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, catches errors in robot actions far more reliably than any competitor but sometimes falls short on descriptive accuracy. Nvidia is positioning Flora as a key piece of its strategy to control the entire robotics value chain. The article Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra appeared first on The Decoder .
